decisions.reason: Closely builds on existing agricultural crate knowledge and design capabilities, so high absorptive capacity supports retention.
Stackable crates are core to the firm's packaging expertise, enabling effective learning and adaptation despite competitive pressure.
Rackable pallets extend existing pallet knowledge and manufacturing, allowing the firm to assimilate market feedback.
Spill-retention pallets require additional safety/environmental knowledge but the firm's pallet expertise and cooperation support learning.
Plastic pallets with load retainers are close to existing pallet offerings, with dedicated promotion indicating commitment and high absorptive capacity.
